rft.loss: continued SFT: mean token NLL of the chosen response only (train_dpo --sft_only; no DPO term, no reference pass, rejected unused); the policy LoRA starts as rpo-dpo1's adapter (--init_adapter) on its training base

rft-s43.loss: continued SFT: mean token NLL of the chosen response only (train_dpo --sft_only; no DPO term, no reference pass, rejected unused); the policy LoRA starts as rpo-dpo1's adapter (--init_adapter) on its training base

pert.loss: sigmoid DPO vs the frozen rpo-dpo1 exact policy (its BF16 training base + its original FP32 adapter, dropout off); the policy LoRA starts as that adapter (train_dpo --init_adapter), so DPO2 starts from rpo-dpo1 exactly; RPO alpha 1.0; pairs: amendment-009 GT chosen vs synthetic perturbation rejected

op-dpo2-s43.loss: sigmoid DPO vs the frozen rpo-dpo1 exact policy (its BF16 training base + its original FP32 adapter, dropout off); the policy LoRA starts as that adapter (train_dpo --init_adapter), so DPO2 starts from rpo-dpo1 exactly

rule: fixed in advance (amendment 016 section 3), on a' (success_debiased) and downstream acceptance (accepted): (d) - (b) with both 95% CIs above 0 -> the preference construction has value beyond its repaired data; (d) ~ (b), operationalised as both CIs of (d) - (b) including 0 (not an equivalence test) -> the contribution is the repair-based data; (c) ~ (d), both CIs of (d) - (c) including 0 -> real failures add nothing over synthetic ones; any other pattern has no pre-registered reading and is reported as measured. Evaluated per training seed ((b), (d) of seed 42 and of seed 43, each against the single-seed (c)); a reading is claimed only when both seeds give it, else seeds_disagree (addenda A5, C8)

seeds.effect: train_dpo --seed sets transformers.set_seed (python, numpy, torch RNG: LoRA dropout masks) and the DistributedSampler seed (per-epoch data order, including the <= 3 rows repeated from the head of the shuffled order to pad an epoch to a multiple of 4, so when N is not a multiple of 4 an epoch's row multiset differs between seeds by those rows); every arm's LoRA starts as rpo-dpo1's adapter (--init_adapter), so the starting weights do not depend on the seed

scope: contrasts: first minus second, paired house-cluster bootstrap on the dev rooms (report_v2.contrasts, 2,000 draws, seed 42); rates over every request (incomplete = failure), size log MAE on rooms complete in both; footprint_bias B: P sizes are the train prior from the request (the placement contract has no size field), so B is the prior's footprint bias on the candidate's complete rooms; tables: per seed, two-seed arithmetic means of (b) and (d), section-5 strata (scale_curve.subsets: object-count bins, real / synthetic, room families) descriptive without CIs; dev only, reported only, never used to select or to touch test
